description: In front of the person are toy sandwich parts on a tabletop: a green plate, two bun halves, and flat pieces that look like cheese, onion ring, tomato, and lettuce. The left hand reaches in from the left to place a bun piece onto the green plate, then adds the pink round slice and a yellow cheese shape on top, while the right hand moves in from the right to add the onion ring, tomato slice, and lettuce leaf, and finally both hands bring the top bun over and press it down to close the sandwich.
